I was comparing prices and I realized you guys are selling Michael Kors boots for a higher price than your competitor.
I would love to support your company but I also would love to save money.
I'm sorry to hear that one of our competitors has a lower price. Could I have your name or account ID?
Account has been pulled up for Crystal Minh.
A reason of competitor has been recorded.
Can you verify your account ID and order ID please?
Thank you. Unfortunately, our prices are set dynamically and I'm unable to change the prices of the products. I do understand that saving money is important.
Is there a discount code or anything you guys give out?
Yes, I can give you a promo code to use on your order with us.
A promo code has been created.
You can use promo code LRK80 for a discount.
Wow! that will certainly help me out and also I am glad I can support your company!
We appreciate your business! Is there anything else I can help you with today?
That was it for today. I appreciate your help
You're welcome. Enjoy the boots and have a nice day!
